_meta.source: Two official in-game notices captured by XYIAN and transcribed 2026-08-24: (1) the Update Preview popup signed 'Archero 2 Team', dated 2026/8/23; (2) the 'Collaboration Event Preview' Notice for the Archero 2 x Rick and Morty crossover. Plus guild recruitment requirements set by XYIAN, effective 2026-08-24.
_meta.confidence: high for the notice text — transcribed verbatim, nothing inferred beyond what the notices state. Season 4 items are ANNOUNCED, not observed in play.

umbral_tempest.overview: Umbral Tempest is a large recurring seasonal event in Archero 2, opened from the bottom action bar on the home screen. It runs in numbered seasons.
umbral_tempest.season_4_status: Umbral Tempest Season 4 begins 31 August 2026. Everything recorded here about Season 4 comes from the in-game Update Preview dated 2026-08-23 and describes the season as ANNOUNCED, not as observed in play.
umbral_tempest.season_4_class_abilities: The Umbral Tempest Season 4 announcement (2026-08-23) names four classes, each receiving a brand-new exclusive ability: Ranger gains 'Sword Intent', Alchemist gains 'Boiling', Druid gains 'Symbiosis', and Diviner gains 'Star Eclipse'. Habby described this as a major upgrade to build variety.
umbral_tempest.season_4_monster_mechanic: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds the 'Main Weapon Restriction Shield' monster mechanic. Announced 2026-08-23.
umbral_tempest.ebonrot_front: Ebonrot Front is named in the Umbral Tempest Season 4 announcement (2026-08-23), which optimizes its difficulty, its unlock pacing, and its weekly resource progression. The announcement gave no further detail about what Ebonrot Front is.
umbral_tempest.doomsday_clash: Doomsday Clash is a boss encounter named in the Umbral Tempest Season 4 announcement (2026-08-23), which optimizes its Boss unlock pacing and adds a solo challenge mode.
umbral_tempest.season_4_launch_missions: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds 7-day Season Launch missions. Announced 2026-08-23.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_system: The Season Talent System is Umbral Tempest's per-season talent tree. Season 4 (announced 2026-08-23) upgrades it with talent branches, special nodes, and 6 class skill nodes, allowing targeted enhancement of class abilities.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_resets: From Umbral Tempest Season 4 (announced 2026-08-23), Season Talent reset rules are 7 resets per week with weekly resets. Habby's stated intent was to make build combinations more flexible.
umbral_tempest.coverage_caveat: Coverage of Umbral Tempest is thin. Everything recorded is from the Season 4 announcement of 2026-08-23; the event's core loop, currencies, rewards and past seasons are NOT documented. Do not infer general Umbral Tempest mechanics from these Season 4 notes.

collaborations.overview: Collaborations are limited-time crossover events in Archero 2 that add guest characters, skins and event gameplay from another franchise.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_overview: The Archero 2 x Rick and Morty crossover was announced in an in-game 'Collaboration Event Preview' Notice. It brings new characters, exclusive gameplay, and a set of limited-time events. Rick & Morty and all related characters are (c) & TM Cartoon Network.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_rick: Rick is a Legendary crossover character. His combat style revolves around [Garage Inventions] and [Inspiration], combining unpredictable outcomes with powerful scaling. Obtained for a limited time through [Interdimensional Summon] during the event.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_morty: Morty is a Legendary crossover character. His gameplay revolves around the cycle between [Morty Waves], [Lame Adventure] and [Aw Geez Adventure]. On entering battle [Morty Waves] activates automatically, periodically cleansing 1 debuff (excluding control effects) from each ally within range while granting [Lame Adventure] stacks. Obtained for a limited time through [Interdimensional Summon].
collaborations.rick_and_morty_meeseeks: Mr. Meeseeks is a Legendary Mystling debuting in the Rick and Morty collab. His combat style is built around rapid triggers and escalating power; when activated, his skill deals damage to enemies in the target area. Obtained through participation or summoning in the [Meeseeks Directive] event during the collab.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_space_adventures: [Space Adventures] is the collab's limited-time themed stage: a two-player co-op challenge mode. The Rick and Morty collab characters are provided for players to use, so the mode focuses on teamwork and on hands-on experience with each character's skills. Entered from the main event screen. Completing battle quests earns event currency and rare items.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_event_features: Five limited-time features run during the collab: [Interdimensional Summon] (recruitment for Rick and Morty), [Prime Protocol] (recruitment for character and weapon skins), [Meeseeks Directive] (obtain the Legendary Mystling Mr. Meeseeks), [21-Day Login Event] (free login rewards through the event period), and [Server Support Pack] plus [Alliance Treasure] (free rewards or high-value rare items).
collaborations.rick_and_morty_skins: [Prime Protocol] is the collab's limited-time skin recruitment, covering both character skins and weapon skins. Each Rick and Morty collab character has 2 skin sets: one based on the original animated style, and one exclusive to Archero 2. This applies to the collab characters, not to the base roster.
collaborations.rick_and_morty_requirements: To access all Rick and Morty collab content, chapter progress must reach Chapter 3 wave 10 or above, which is what unlocks the in-game event system. The [Alliance Treasure] gameplay additionally requires the player to have joined a guild.

requirements.overview: The Arch 2 Addicts community runs two Archero 2 guilds. Both carry the same activity standards; only the power minimum differs. Set by XYIAN, effective 2026-08-24.
requirements.xyian_official_power: XYIAN OFFICIAL (Guild ID 213797), the founding guild, requires 8M+ power.
requirements.projectxy_power: ProjectXY (Guild ID 214890), the sister guild and the primary home for new members, requires 6M+ power.
requirements.shared_activity: Both guilds require the same activity: daily Monster Invasion (the guild boss battle, called MI) and guild research at 2x minimum per day; daily guild donations at 2x minimum per day; and being active in Discord. The donation minimum is 2 rather than 1 because the first donation of the day is free, so a single donation costs nothing and proves nothing.
requirements.why_two_guilds: XYIAN OFFICIAL filled up, so ProjectXY was created as a sister guild in August 2026. One community, one Discord, and a deliberate commitment not to expand past a single sub-guild.

starlight_celebration.overview: Guild Starlight Celebration is a guild event announced in the in-game Update Preview dated 2026-08-23, shipping with that week's hotfix update. It highlights the guild's standout members from the previous week.
starlight_celebration.how_winners_are_chosen: Multiple honorary awards and a Guild MVP are selected based on guild members' activity and contributions during the PREVIOUS week.
starlight_celebration.during_the_event: Players can watch the award ceremony, send emojis to interact with it, and claim rewards.

guild_hall.contents: PRE-UPGRADE LAYOUT — the Guild Hall UI was fully upgraded on 2026-08-23 and this may no longer match the current screen. Before that upgrade it showed: guild name, ID, emblem with guild level, member count, Recruit button, aggregate guild power, guild XP progress bar toward the next level, and a leader-editable description box.
guild_hall.ui_upgraded_2026_08_23: The Guild Hall was fully upgraded in the update announced 2026-08-23: a new UI that centralises guild information and the access points for guild features. What the new UI contains is NOT recorded. Every other guild_hall detail here describes the pre-upgrade screen — say so when describing the Guild Hall.

characters.acquisition_event_only_heroes: The event-only heroes — obtainable ONLY during a limited-time event — are: Nezha, Wukong, Rick, and Morty. Nezha and Wukong each return with their own recurring event; Rick and Morty come from [Interdimensional Summon] during the Archero 2 x Rick and Morty collab.

custom_facts.text: An in-game Update Preview dated 2026-08-23 announced a hotfix update for that week, bringing a brand-new chapter, the Guild Starlight Celebration, and Umbral Tempest Season 4.
The hotfix announced on 2026-08-23 adds Main Chapters 191-200 and Heroic Chapters 176-185.

The Guild Hall was fully upgraded in the hotfix announced on 2026-08-23: a new UI that centralises guild information and the access points for guild features. Any description of the Guild Hall screen layout in these notes predates that upgrade.
The hotfix announced on 2026-08-23 adds combat scene switching in the profile interface, so Arena and Peak Arena can be set to different combat scenes.
Starlight Cup and Super Starlight Cup battles were optimized in the hotfix announced on 2026-08-23: Boss death animations were removed, and stage timers pause while you are selecting a Boss.
The hotfix announced on 2026-08-23 adds 100x draws to Equipment Chests, a x10 option to Quick Hunt, and a one-click unequip function for Rune Presets.
The hotfix announced on 2026-08-23 adds new achievements for player level, new stages, and other related milestones.
